versions.subject: Update Ref+Selection 2
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    - Image|endswith:
        - '\net.exe'
        - '\net1.exe'
    - OriginalFileName:
        - 'net.exe'
        - 'net1.exe'
selection_cli:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - 'share'
        - '/delete'
condition: all of selection*
versions.spl: Image IN ("*\\net.exe", "*\\net1.exe") OR OriginalFileName IN ("net.exe", "net1.exe") CommandLine="*share*" CommandLine="*/delete*"
